Methods. Change scores are final minus baseline; on this symptom scale lower is better, so negative change means improvement.

Participant flow. Sixty participants were randomized (30 per arm). In the control arm, two withdrew before week 12, leaving 28 analyzed for the primary outcome. In the treatment arm, 31 were analyzed because one participant randomized late was included.

Table 1. Baseline symptom score (mean): treatment 5.2, control 5.1.

Table 2. Week-12 symptom score (mean): treatment 3.9, control 4.8. Mean change from baseline: treatment -1.3, control -0.3. Adverse events (any): treatment 12 of 31, control 9 of 28.
